key_provisions_or_claims: The bill's merits include creating a professional association and defining its advisory and standard-setting functions.
Demerits: limited regulatory scope, no guiding principles, weak enforcement powers, no AI inventory or disclosure.
Recommends adding clear regulatory guiding principles to the bill.
Recommends stronger enforcement mechanisms and mandatory AI system inventory and disclosure.
named_instruments_referenced: Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill 2023
annotation.summary_en: Journal article appraising Kenya's proposed Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023. It reviews the difficulty of regulating AI and robotics and global trends, then weighs the bill's merits (a professional body) against its demerits (narrow scope, no guiding principles, weak enforcement). It proposes amendments on principles, enforcement, AI inventory and disclosure, and inter-agency collaboration.
